name: second-look
description: Browser extension that helps Devpost judges spot projects worth a second look

scripts.package:chrome: npm run build && mkdir -p release && rm -f release/second-look-chrome.zip && cd dist/chrome && zip -qrX ../../release/second-look-chrome.zip .
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build && npx --yes web-ext@8 sign --channel=unlisted --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir release
